summary: Phase 2 e2e testing: reports (Excel/PDF) + dashboard filters + employee department validation. 30/30 backend pytest cases pass (12 new Phase-2 cases added). All frontend Phase-2 flows verified via Playwright with actual blob downloads.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.js resets `setB(null)` on each filter change and shows 'Chargement…' — good UX, but no error state if /api/budget fails (silent hang).
Rapports.js download() catches all errors silently with a single 'Export échoué' toast — could log the actual error for easier debugging.
api.downloadReport does not surface HTTP errors from blob responses (axios returns blob even on 401/500); consider validating content-type or size before offering the download.
Department validation on employee create/update is now correct — recommendation: also validate on Excel import (POST /api/employees/import) to keep parity.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. TEST_* rows created inside pytest are all deleted in-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite (30 tests, ~5s): Phase 1 (18) + Phase 2 added — TestReports (7: auth-required 401 for excel/pdf, 200+xlsx-magic PK, PDF %PDF header, filtered dept=810 variants, journal entry created), TestDeptValidation (3: bad dept POST/PUT → 400 'inexistant', valid dept ok), TestBudgetFilter (2: dept filter narrows lines+headcount, unknown dept → empty). Frontend Playwright verified: login → dashboard, dashboard dept filter (all→810 changes kpi-employes 6→1 and 'entrée(s) affichée(s)' to 1, backend called with ?department=810), Rapports page (report-department filter changes 'Aperçu — Ventilation' label from 'Tous les départements' to 'Électriciens'), Excel export downloads rapport_budget_2026_810.xlsx, PDF export downloads rapport_budget_2026_810.pdf, journal shows 'Rapport — Export Excel — 810' / 'Rapport — Export PDF — 810' entries, all 7 sidebar nav items still render, employee dialog still opens. Année selector fixed to 2026 (disabled) on both Dashboard and Rapports. No console errors observed.
